description: This file contains a test script for interaction with Perforce (P4) involving case-folding, repository cloning, and file addition. It sets up a P4 server with case-insensitive filesystem support, creates repositories with different cases, and tests the behavior of cloning under these conditions.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Check for prerequisite presence, e.g., case-insensitive filesystem support.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Start a Perforce server instance with specific options, such as case folding.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Configure client view mappings for the Perforce workspace.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Define a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Define a test case that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verify that a given path is a file.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clone a Perforce depot into a Git repository using 'git p4'.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Assert that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Mark the end of the test script.
